map.MA=肌肉插入力臂 rIn / 肢段长 r，本工具固定 rIn=0.05 m。肢: MA = muscle insertion lever arm rIn / segment length r; this tool fixes rIn = 0.05 m. The longer the segment, the larger r and the smaller MA, and the more effort is needed, which means muscles close to the joint have a low lever efficiency and must produce more force. It also shows that holding the load farther out increases the moment arm and adjusts force production efficiency.

map.健身或康复训练评估动作生物力学时，量化肢段在某关节角度下承受的力矩与肌肉需产生的: When fitness or rehabilitation training evaluates the biomechanics of a movement, it quantifies the moment a segment bears at a given joint angle and the force the muscle must produce, to judge whether the load is reasonable and whether compensation is likely.
map.力学优势 MA 怎么看？: How Do You Read the Mechanical Advantage MA?
map.力矩=力×力臂×sinθ，90° 时 sinθ=1 有效力臂最大、关节力矩最大，: Moment = force × lever arm × sinθ. At 90° sinθ=1, so the effective lever arm and the joint moment are largest and the muscle must produce the greatest force; as the angle decreases sinθ falls and the moment decreases (less effort but also less stimulus).
map.可复现算例：90° 持负荷的关节力矩: Reproducible example: joint moment while holding a load at 90°
map.物理治疗师设计渐进抗阻方案时，比较 30°/60°/90° 等不同角度下的肌力需: When a physical therapist designs a progressive resistance program, they compare the muscle force demands at different angles such as 30°, 60°, and 90° to determine a safe and effective training angle.
map.理解「力学优势」(插入力臂/肢段长)：为什么靠近关节发力更费力，指导握距、力点与: Understand the "mechanical advantage" (insertion lever arm / segment length): why force near the joint is more effortful, which guides grip distance, the point of force application, and protective gear selection.
